text:
lee: Heads up — onboarding hit a weird friction on Windows CI. The `ruby-sdk` gem pulls in an FFI extension we don't build on the matrix runner, so local devs get a native build error and the sampleapp CI flakes.

maria_devex: ugh, is this the `ffi` gem C extension or our own C ext? any stack/logs?

aj: Looks like `ffi` native build. Error snippet from CI: `mkmf.rb can't find header for ruby.h` then `make: *** No rule to make target`. Happens on msys2/msvcrt runners.

lee: repro steps I used: `ruby -v` 3.1.2, `gem install ruby-sdk` -> `gem native extension` fails. Local fix was `ridk install` but that's not acceptable for sampleapp onboarding.

sophie: Could we bundle a pure-ruby fallback? Or vendor the precompiled binary for common windows targets?

maria_devex: fallback is preferable for DX, but shipping binaries opens up CI matrix/version support maintenance. Another angle: detect platform in gemspec and mark `ffi` as development-only when running sampleapp quickstart?

aj: hmm that would hide problems for users who actually need system lib. Maybe we add clearer onboarding docs and a small `setup_windows.md` with `ridk` steps and known CI images. Also we could add a lightweight check in sampleapp that prints a helpful message rather than failing hard.

lee: I'm fine with a friendly early-check. Minimal change: rescue the `require 'ffi'` and print actionable instructions with suggestions: `ridk install`, `pacman -S mingw-w64-x86_64-ruby` etc.

maria_devex: That plus a PR to our docs + a CI tweak (use ruby:3.1.2-mingw32 image for windows job) should unblock onboarding. Can someone pick the PR?

aj: I'll open a small PR: - add `rescue` and user-friendly error in `lib/ruby_sdk/ffi_loader.rb` - add `docs/windows-quickstart.md` - update windows CI job to use mingw image for the sampleapp job.

ci-bot: build #4821 (sampleapp/windows) failed: `mkmf.rb can't find header for ruby.h` — see https://ci.example/4821

lee: thanks! also can we avoid rolling this into a major release? it's just a DX fix — a patch release would be ideal.

maria_devex: Agreed. AJ — after you open the PR add `changelog: patch` and request a backport to the current release branch (0.8.x). We'll do QA on mac/linux matrix but keep the windows fix as small as possible.

aj: PR opened: 2105556899-ruby-windows-ffi-friendly-fallback. Includes repro doc and CI image tweak. ping @sophie for review when you have a minute.

sophie: Reviewing now. Small nit: prefer `warn` message with link to docs instead of raising. Also add a test that simulates `LoadError` to ensure we don't regress.

aj: added test and replaced raise with `warn` + telemetry event `sdk.ffi_missing`.

lee: verified local repro with `rvm use 3.1.2` + `gem i .` — error handled and message printed. CI passes on linux/macos. Windows job still flaky on hosted runner but passes on mingw image.

maria_devex: cool. going to schedule the patch release cut after merge and add a short note to the onboarding guide. Thanks y'all — nice focused DX win. :tada:

lee: thanks — will follow up if any customers hit the issue.
